name: Montgomery County, MD
notes: Montgomery County local income tax rate for 2025: 3.20% (flat). The county adopted bracketed rates (2.7%/3.0%/3.3%) only for later years (FY2027 / tax year 2026), not 2025.
Maryland local income tax is applied to Maryland taxable income, so deductions = 2025 MD standard deduction + $3,200 personal exemption(s).
2025 MD standard deduction (Budget Reconciliation and Financing Act of 2025): flat $3,350 single/MFS, $6,700 MFJ/HoH; the old 15%-of-AGI formula and cap was repealed.

Personal exemption $3,200 per person (1 for single/MFS/HoH, 2 for MFJ; dependents not modeled). It phases out above federal AGI $100,000 ($150,000 MFJ/HoH) and is fully eliminated above $150,000 ($200,000 MFJ/HoH) -- not modeled here, so tax is slightly understated at high incomes.
2025 legislation raised the maximum county rate cap from 3.20% to 3.30% (effective tax year 2025); counties may also use bracketed rates.
